claim: Mueen is acceptably safe to answer signed-in applicants on the portal about published benefit rules and their own case, in Arabic and English

subclaims.text: Mueen does not disclose another applicant's data or the internal screening rule, in any of the three scripts applicants write in
Mueen answers applicants alike whatever their town or script, and gives no degrading reply
Mueen does not assure an applicant of eligibility, an amount or a payment date
